buildings.name: Chieftain hut
buildings.description: The seat of your chief. Every nation starts with one at its capital, and it earns a little gold without needing workers.

buildings.name: Great hall
buildings.description: The chief's Medieval hall, upgraded from the hut. It earns more gold, still without workers.

buildings.name: Town hall
buildings.description: The seat of a Gunpowder-era town, upgraded from the great hall. It earns more gold again, without workers.

buildings.name: Parliament
buildings.description: The seat of an Industrial government, upgraded from the town hall. It earns the most gold of the line, without workers.

buildings.name: Wooden watchtower
buildings.description: A wooden lookout on your land: land within 3 plots of it defends at 1.15 times.

buildings.name: Stone tower
buildings.description: A Medieval stone tower, upgraded from the watchtower: land within 4 plots defends at 1.3 times.

buildings.name: Concrete tower
buildings.description: A Modern concrete tower: land within 5 plots of it defends at 1.6 times.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Trains every soldier type your research has unlocked, twice as fast as a war camp. Set how many to keep in the Army panel.

buildings.name: Storage yard
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Logistics depot
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Jetty
buildings.description: A landing on the shore. It sends trade ships to other ports, earning gold, and troops landed near it lose nobody.

buildings.name: Harbour
buildings.description: A Medieval harbour, upgraded from the jetty. It sends trade ships for gold, builds galleys and cogs, and landings near it lose nobody.

buildings.name: Commercial port
buildings.description: A large Industrial port that sends trade ships for gold. Troops landed near it lose nobody.

buildings.name: Offshore rig
buildings.description: A platform on shallow water, meant for oil and gas at sea. It has no effect yet.

buildings.name: Grass hut
buildings.description: A home your people build by themselves on residential zones. Residents pay tax, take jobs and raise your troop limit.

buildings.name: Timber cottage
buildings.description: A Medieval timber home. Your people upgrade huts to cottages once they have work and are not taxed too hard.

buildings.name: Brick house
buildings.description: A Gunpowder-era brick home with room for more people.

buildings.name: Tenement
buildings.description: An Industrial block of flats that fits many families on one plot.

buildings.name: Apartment block
buildings.description: A Modern apartment block that houses hundreds of people.

buildings.name: Eco tower
buildings.description: A Future green tower that an apartment block grows into: 900 people. It grows into an arcology.

buildings.name: Market stall
buildings.description: A stall your people set up on commercial zones. It gives them work, and people without work are less content.

buildings.name: Bakery
buildings.description: A Medieval bakery, upgraded from a stall, with more jobs.

buildings.name: General store
buildings.description: A Gunpowder-era store with more jobs.

buildings.name: Shop
buildings.description: An Industrial shop with more jobs.

buildings.name: Cafe
buildings.description: A Modern cafe. In a busy downtown, with 6 shops within 4 plots and roads on two sides, it grows into an office block.

buildings.name: Forge
buildings.description: A Medieval workshop your people set up on industrial zones. It gives work and earns gold.

buildings.name: Foundry
buildings.description: A Gunpowder-era works, upgraded from the forge, that earns more gold and gives more work.

buildings.name: Early factory
buildings.description: An Industrial factory your people build on industrial zones. It earns gold in bulk.

buildings.name: Modern factory
buildings.description: A Modern factory, the biggest earner of any works.

buildings.name: Woodcutter camp
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Quarry
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Clay pit
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Fishing hut
buildings.description: Earns gold from fishing. It needs fishing water close by.

buildings.name: Wheat field
buildings.description: A wheat field that earns gold. Fertile soil yields more; summer gives the most and winter the least.

buildings.name: Sheep pasture
buildings.description: Sheep grazing on grassland earn gold. They yield less in winter.

buildings.name: Cattle pasture
buildings.description: Cattle grazing on grassland. A little more gold than sheep, and less in winter.

buildings.name: Pit mine
buildings.description: A Medieval mine on iron, copper, tin, coal, gold, silver or gems. Richer deposits earn more gold, until the deposit runs dry.

buildings.name: Sawmill
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Fishing dock
buildings.description: A Medieval dock, upgraded from the fishing hut, that earns more from fishing.

buildings.name: Mine shaft
buildings.description: An Industrial deep mine. It earns faster than a pit mine and also reaches uranium, bauxite and sulfur.

buildings.name: Open-pit mine
buildings.description: A Modern open-pit mine, the fastest there is, on iron, copper, coal, bauxite and lithium under or right beside it.

buildings.name: Oil derrick
buildings.description: Pumps oil and earns gold for it. It must sit on an oil deposit.

buildings.name: Pumpjack
buildings.description: A Modern pump, upgraded from the derrick, that earns gold from oil faster.

buildings.name: War camp
buildings.description: Where levies train as club warriors, spear throwers and horse archers. Set how many to keep in the Army panel.

buildings.name: Siege workshop
buildings.description: Builds catapults and trebuchets, one after another from its queue.

buildings.name: Gas plant
buildings.description: Draws natural gas and earns gold for it. It must sit on a gas deposit.

buildings.name: Bank
buildings.description: Keeps and lends your nation's gold: income rises by 8% for each bank, counting up to 5.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.description: Books for your scholars: 0.2 more research points a second each, counting up to 5 libraries.

buildings.name: School
buildings.description: Teaches your children: 0.1 more research points a second each, counting up to 10 schools.

buildings.name: Theatre
buildings.description: Plays and music: ticket sales earn a little gold, and each theatre makes your towns grow 5% faster, up to 4.

buildings.name: Courthouse
buildings.description: Law and order: your troop cap rises by 3% for each courthouse, counting up to 5.

buildings.name: Star fort
buildings.description: A low, angled fort for the cannon age: your land within 6 plots defends at 1.5 times.

buildings.name: Cannon foundry
buildings.description: Casts cannons, one after another from its queue.

buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.description: Builds galleons, frigates and ships of the line. It sends trade ships for gold, and troops landed near it lose nobody.

buildings.name: Steel mill
buildings.description: No longer built: materials are gone and every cost is in gold. Old ones are taken down and their cost refunded.

buildings.name: Textile mill
buildings.description: An Industrial mill your people build on industrial zones. It earns gold with fewer workers than a factory.

buildings.name: University
buildings.description: Higher learning: research is 12% faster for each university, counting up to 3.

buildings.name: Clinic
buildings.description: Doctors for your towns: population grows 10% faster for each clinic, counting up to 5.

buildings.name: Tax office
buildings.description: Collects what is owed: income rises by 5% for each tax office, counting up to 5.

buildings.name: Vehicle factory
buildings.description: Builds artillery, tanks and other vehicles, one after another from its queue.

buildings.name: Naval dock
buildings.description: Builds steamships, ironclads and destroyers. It sends trade ships for gold, and troops landed near it lose nobody.

buildings.name: Bunker
buildings.description: A concrete strongpoint for machine guns: your land within 3 plots defends at 1.4 times.

buildings.name: Railway station
buildings.description: A large railway station. Trains run from it along your rail to your other stations, earning gold for each trip.

buildings.name: Coal plant
buildings.description: Makes 20 power for Industrial buildings within 6 plots, and further along power poles, for 0.6 gold a second at full load.

buildings.name: Power pole
buildings.description: Carries your power grid 4 plots further. Drag a line of them from a coal plant, like a road.

buildings.name: Airfield
buildings.description: Builds planes and helicopters and is their base: they fly from it and rearm there, 4 at a time. Its guns hit enemy planes within 2 plots.

buildings.name: Flak tower
buildings.description: Anti-aircraft guns: enemy planes within 4 plots lose 6 health a second.

buildings.name: Air base
buildings.description: A Modern air base: its planes reach half as far again as from an airfield, 12 rearm at once, and its guns hit enemy planes within 3 plots.

buildings.name: SAM site
buildings.description: Fires missiles at enemy planes within 8 plots: it holds 4 and reloads one every 15 s for 60 gold. A second site over the same sky adds half as much.

buildings.name: Missile silo
buildings.description: Builds and holds one missile to launch at enemy land: a nuclear warhead or a conventional cruise missile. Missile defences near the target may shoot it down.

buildings.name: ABM silo
buildings.description: Shoots down a nuclear warhead falling within 20 plots 60% of the time. Holds 2 interceptors and makes one every 3 minutes for 1,500 gold.

buildings.name: Park
buildings.description: Visitors come for the green: 0.25 gold a second. A new kind of attraction pays more than another copy.

buildings.name: Plaza
buildings.description: A paved square with a fountain that draws visitors: 0.3 gold a second.

buildings.name: Museum
buildings.description: Collections that draw visitors: 1.4 gold a second.

buildings.name: Zoo
buildings.description: Animals from far away: 2.4 gold a second from visitors.

buildings.name: Arena
buildings.description: Matches and shows: 3 gold a second from visitors.

buildings.name: Stadium
buildings.description: Big games bring big crowds: 6.5 gold a second from visitors.

buildings.name: Casino
buildings.description: Visitors come to gamble: 4.5 gold a second.

buildings.name: Luxury hotel
buildings.description: Rich visitors stay a while: 3.5 gold a second.

buildings.name: Beach resort
buildings.description: On the coast: 4.5 gold a second, 60% more in summer and 70% less in winter at its latitude.

buildings.name: Ski resort
buildings.description: Within 3 plots of hills or mountains: 4.5 gold a second, 80% more in winter and far less in summer.

buildings.name: Office block
buildings.description: A shop grown into offices in a busy downtown with roads on two sides: 40 jobs, and it makes the city core harder to take.

buildings.name: Skyscraper
buildings.description: The heart of a downtown: 160 jobs, and the city core around it is much harder to take.

buildings.name: Stone circle
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 1.5 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Great pyramid
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 2.5 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Colossus
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 3.5 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Hanging gardens
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 4 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Clock tower
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 6 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Triumphal arch
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 6.5 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Grand tower
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 9 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Great exhibition
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 10 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Observatory
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 14 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Fusion reactor
buildings.description: Makes 150 power for buildings within 10 plots, and further along power poles. It burns no fuel, so it costs nothing to run.

buildings.name: Vertical farm
buildings.description: A Future farm stacked under lights. It earns the same on any buildable ground in every season, and needs power to run at full rate.

buildings.name: Dome habitat
buildings.description: A sealed Future home that your people build on new residential land: 700 people. It grows into an arcology.

buildings.name: Arcology
buildings.description: A city in one building: 2,400 people and 300 jobs. It grows from an eco tower or dome habitat and takes in the homes inside its 3 by 3 plots.

buildings.name: Orbital elevator
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 20 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Launch complex
buildings.description: A wonder: one per world, owned by whoever finishes it first. 18 gold a second from visitors, and 10% more for all your tourism.

buildings.name: Drone hangar
buildings.description: Builds recon drones, strike drones and VTOL gunships, and is their base: they need no runway, and 6 recharge at once. Other planes cannot use it.

buildings.name: Shield generator
buildings.description: Covers 12 plots: it stops 80% of missiles and warheads falling there, and enemy bombs do half harm and leave buildings standing. Needs power.

buildings.name: Shield node
buildings.description: A small shield over 5 plots: it stops 60% of missiles and warheads falling there, and enemy bombs do half harm. Needs power.

buildings.name: Railgun battery
buildings.description: Fires every 4 s at the nearest enemy company or vessel within 10 plots: a company loses 12 troops, a machine 30 health. Off the grid it fires half as often.

buildings.name: Orbital uplink
buildings.description: Builds an orbital strike and calls it down on enemy land anywhere in 10 s. Only shields can stop it. It counts as a nuclear weapon.
